summary: Backend-only testing of new features: 5-char ref code, admin manual inspection, public lookup, ntfy alerts, OG image/meta + regression. 19/19 pytest tests passed. Test data cleaned up (inspections/users/album).
critical_code_review_comments: Passwords stored in plaintext and returned by GET /api/users (pre-existing design choice) - security risk.
/api/lookup/{code} is unauthenticated with a 32^5 (~33M) keyspace and no rate limiting; consider rate limiting to prevent enumeration of client names/photos/reports.
send_alert: ntfy success check only accepts status 200; fine for ntfy but consider r.is_success.
og_image: malformed album data (no comma / bad base64) would raise 500; minor - wrap in try/except and fall back to redirect.
Lookup returns 'report' and 'components' raw - ensure no sensitive internal notes are stored there.
test_credentials: admin@torqueelite.com / admin123 (memory/test_credentials.md has no entries - main agent should populate it)
seed_data_creation: None persisted; all TEST_ data removed in fixture teardown. 2 real ntfy notifications were sent (1 booking alert, 1 test alert).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: booking ref matches ^[A-HJ-NP-Z2-9]{5}$, alert_log entry starts 'Vous recevez une nouvelle inspection' with success true; manual create 401/403/422/404 cases, manual:true, assigned status with employee_id, email lowercased; lookup case-insensitive + trimmed, excludes client_id/price/location/contact/payment/id, client only {name}; 404 'Code de référence introuvable'; alerts config/test admin-only; og-image 307->unsplash when album empty, returns bytes with correct mime when album has image; index.html og:title and absolute og:image. All 14 existing inspections have ref.
